decision_conditions:
Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order) no part(s) of the roof of the building(s) hereby approved shall be used as a balcony or terrace nor shall any access be formed thereto.
REASON: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of adjoining property.
description: Single storey ground floor rear extension with patio and glass balustrades. 4 velux flat roof lights, 11 Solar panels on extension roof. New steps down to garden. Rectangular window and doors to rear elevation. Change all timber casement windows to grey heritage UPVC casement windows, Two windows removed from side elevation 1. Creation of habitable space in garage. New timber front door and side windows installed further towards front elevation. New garage door with high level windows. Demolish front boundary wall and rebuild in London Stock brick, new timber sliding vehicle gate, new pedestrian gate and steps, bike store in front garden, timber garden store at rear of side elevation. Beige render painted white on side and rear elevations, beige render on front elevation replaced with white render. Black painted timber features repainted in grey.
